# Education & learning

AI tutors, classroom assistants, study aids, and no-code machine-learning projects. The free landscape is unusually generous for verified teachers, while student access can be more limited. These tools support learning; they do not replace a teacher, a graded rubric, or your own work.

**Last verified:** October 22, 2026 · **14 tools**

[Back to the guide](../README.md) · [All categories](README.md) · [Safety checklist](../free-tier-safety.md)

> **Category tip:** Use AI to ask better questions, generate practice, and explain a sticking point, not to hand in work you did not do. Check your school's rules, verify facts and calculations, and treat tutor answers as hints to investigate. For classroom tools, protect student privacy and follow district policy.

**Start here:** [Khanmigo](#tool-khanmigo) · [MagicSchool](#tool-magicschool) · [Wolfram|Alpha](#tool-wolfram-alpha)

## All 14 tools

<a id="tool-khanmigo"></a>

### Khanmigo

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Khan Academy's AI tutor and teaching assistant is free for verified teachers in supported regions, with tutoring and lesson-planning support.
- **Sign-up notes:** Khan Academy account plus teacher verification for free educator access. Students generally need a paid plan; no card for eligible teachers.
- **Limits:** Student and parent accounts generally require a paid subscription. Free teacher access depends on verification, geography, and current program availability. Tutors can make mistakes.
- **Best for:** Teachers who want Socratic-style question prompts and planning help tied to Khan Academy material.
- **Official link:** <https://www.khanmigo.ai>
- **Tags:** `tutoring` `teachers` `khan-academy` `lesson-planning`

<a id="tool-duolingo"></a>

### Duolingo

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free language lessons in many languages, with streaks, practice exercises, stories, and some AI-powered feedback on the free plan.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free account; no card. Ads and heart or feature limits apply.
- **Limits:** Ads, hearts, and feature limits apply; advanced personalization, unlimited mistakes, and some AI features require Super or Max. AI feedback is not a human conversation partner.
- **Best for:** Building a daily language habit and practicing vocabulary at no cost.
- **Official link:** <https://www.duolingo.com>
- **Tags:** `language-learning` `practice` `habit` `beginner`

<a id="tool-quizlet"></a>

### Quizlet

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free flashcard sets, practice tests, study modes, and a limited amount of AI-assisted study help.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free account; no card. AI and offline features are limited.
- **Limits:** AI features, offline access, and ad removal are restricted or paid. User-created sets vary in accuracy, and AI-generated explanations need checking.
- **Best for:** Turning vocabulary or definitions into flashcards and self-testing before an exam.
- **Official link:** <https://quizlet.com>
- **Tags:** `flashcards` `study` `exam-prep` `students`

<a id="tool-kahoot"></a>

### Kahoot!

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free live quizzes and classroom games, with basic question creation and a limited amount of AI-assisted question generation for teachers.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free account; no card. AI question generation and reports are capped.
- **Limits:** AI question generation, advanced reports, and larger/team features are capped or paid. Teachers should review AI-generated questions for errors and bias before class.
- **Best for:** Quick review games and active recall in a classroom or study group.
- **Official link:** <https://kahoot.com>
- **Tags:** `quizzes` `classroom` `teachers` `review`

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** A free teacher plan for creating quizzes and lessons, with AI tools for question generation and some student-paced practice.

### MagicSchool

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** A free educator plan with a collection of AI tools for lesson plans, rubrics, emails, differentiation, and classroom feedback.

<a id="tool-diffit"></a>

### Diffit

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free AI help adapting texts and creating reading supports, vocabulary, and question sets at different levels.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free account; no card. Monthly resource limits apply.
- **Limits:** Free monthly resources and some formats/features are limited. Generated adaptations need a teacher's review for accuracy, age-appropriateness, and reading level.

<a id="tool-brisk-teaching"></a>

### Brisk Teaching

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** A free Chrome extension that helps teachers give feedback, adapt materials, and generate lesson resources from what is on screen.
- **Sign-up notes:** Chrome extension with a free teacher account; no card. AI action limits and school policies apply.
- **Limits:** Free AI actions and advanced features are limited. The extension sees page content, so avoid student records or confidential material. Review feedback before returning it.
- **Best for:** Fast feedback and lesson tweaks inside the tools a teacher already uses.
- **Official link:** <https://www.briskteaching.com>
- **Tags:** `teachers` `feedback` `chrome` `differentiation`

<a id="tool-socratic"></a>

### Socratic by Google

`Free` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free mobile homework help: take a photo of a question and get explanations, relevant learning resources, and step-by-step guidance.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free app download; no account or card required.
- **Limits:** The app is free, but answers can be incomplete or wrong and coverage varies by subject. It is a study aid, not a guarantee of the correct answer or a substitute for showing your work.
- **Best for:** Middle school through college students who want an explanation of a homework question.
- **Official link:** <https://socratic.org>
- **Tags:** `homework` `students` `photo` `explanations`

<a id="tool-photomath"></a>

### Photomath

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free math scanning and step-by-step explanations for many core arithmetic, algebra, and other problems.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free app download; no card. Some solutions and features require an upgrade.
- **Limits:** Some advanced problem types, solutions, and features require Plus or Max. The app may show ads. Always check the reasoning rather than copying the final answer.
- **Best for:** Getting unstuck on a math problem and seeing one possible route to the solution.
- **Official link:** <https://photomath.com>
- **Tags:** `math` `homework` `scanning` `students`

<a id="tool-wolfram-alpha"></a>

### Wolfram|Alpha

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free computational answers, plots, unit conversions, and topic lookups across math, science, and general knowledge.
- **Sign-up notes:** No account needed for basic queries; no card. Step-by-step and extended features may require Pro.
- **Limits:** Step-by-step solutions, extended computation time, and some data/features require Pro. The free website still shows results, but the depth and export options are limited.
- **Best for:** Checking calculations and exploring math or science with a reliable computational engine.
- **Official link:** <https://www.wolframalpha.com>
- **Tags:** `math` `science` `computation` `reference`

<a id="tool-teachable-machine"></a>

### Teachable Machine

`Free` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** A free Google browser tool for training simple image, sound, and pose classification models with your own examples, no coding required.
- **Sign-up notes:** Open the browser tool with no account or card. Uploads are processed by the browser or Google depending on the mode.
- **Limits:** It is an educational tool, not a production ML platform. Quality depends on data and training choices, models can be small or biased, and uploads may be processed by Google.
- **Best for:** Hands-on lessons about how machine learning recognizes images, sounds, or poses.
- **Official link:** <https://teachablemachine.withgoogle.com>
- **Tags:** `machine-learning` `no-code` `projects` `teachers`
